title: Pattern Named to the 2026 America's Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, as Featured in the Wall Street Journal
body_markdown:
*Recognition reflects independent employee data and industry-leading emotional connectedness*


**LEHI, Utah, November 5, 2026** — Pattern Group Inc. (Nasdaq: PTRN) (“Pattern”), a leader in accelerating brands on global ecommerce marketplaces, today announced it has been named to the 2026 America's Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, as featured in the Wall Street Journal. Pattern ranked No. 25 on the list, placing it among 100 companies across 30+ industries where employees demonstrate the highest levels of commitment to their work, their teams, and their organizations.


“Our brand partners’ success begins with our people and a culture that empowers them to do their best work,” said Mel Alder, Co-founder and Board Member, Pattern. “This recognition is especially meaningful because it reflects the experiences of our team members and the workplace we’ve built together. I’m incredibly proud of how our people support one another, live our values, and turn their shared commitment into exceptional results for our partners.”


The America's Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® list is produced by Most Loved Workplace® and Best Practice Institute, and evaluated through the Love of Workplace Index™ — an independent methodology built on employee sentiment data from more than 2.5 million U.S. employees. Companies are assessed on the degree to which employees love where they work, not on self-reported claims or purchased placements.


That experience is rooted in Pattern's four core values — Game Changer, Data Fanatic, Partner Obsessed, and Team of Doers — which Pattern employees around the world recognize in one another each quarter and celebrate together every year during Values Week.


Based on Best Practice Institute research, validated across 1,800+ companies, organizations with the highest levels of emotional connectedness see 48% lower turnover and consistently out-innovate their competitors.


Pattern's full profile is available at mostlovedworkplace.com/companies/pattern. The complete 2026 America's Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® list is available at mostlovedworkplace.com/americas-top-most-loved-workplaces-2026.


**About Pattern**


‍Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 100 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates key levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across more than 80 global marketplaces—including Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, JD, and Mercado Libre.


**About Most Loved Workplace®**


Most Loved Workplace® is the certification and recognition organization that measures emotional connectedness at work through the Love of Workplace Index™. Founded by Louis Carter, Most Loved Workplace® works with organizations across industries to surface, validate, and activate the employee voice that drives retention, performance, and growth. Learn more at[mostlovedworkplace.com](http://mostlovedworkplace.com/) .
